existing.description: The Future Leaders Scholarship is an RMIT University award that gives students from India and the subcontinent a 20% tuition fee reduction for eligible Bachelor and Masters by coursework programs. Applicants must already hold an RMIT offer letter to commence from 2026 intakes onwards in a program that is eligible for the award, and be citizens of India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Nepal or Pakistan. No separate scholarship application is required; the reduction is applied automatically and appears on the offer letter. The scholarship is not combined with other RMIT funded tuition-fee scholarships or an Australia Awards scholarship.
eligibility: Be a citizen of India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Nepal or Pakistan (including dual citizenship holding one of these countries' passports)
Be an international student holding a valid student visa or plan to apply for a student visa prior to program commencement
Have an offer letter to commence from 2026 intakes onwards in a Bachelor degree or Masters by Coursework program at RMIT
Not be an existing student who commences in another program within the same study level
Not be in receipt of any other RMIT funded scholarship or Australia Awards scholarship covering tuition fees (applicants holding a scholarship loan may be considered)
existing.eligibility_summary: International students who are citizens of India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Nepal or Pakistan, hold or will hold a student visa, and hold an RMIT offer letter to commence from 2026 intakes onwards in a Bachelor degree or Masters by Coursework program that is eligible for the scholarship.
benefits: 20% tuition fee reduction for the duration of the eligible program as outlined in the offer letter
coverage: 20% tuition fee reduction for the duration of the eligible program
requirements: Check if your program is eligible to receive the scholarship
Submit an application to study at RMIT
documents: RMIT offer letter for an eligible Bachelor degree or Masters by Coursework program commencing from 2026 intakes onwards
Evidence of citizenship of India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Nepal or Pakistan
Student visa, or evidence of intention to apply for a student visa before program commencement
existing.english_requirement: Students with an RMIT English packaged offer are eligible for this scholarship when they meet the required English level of the eligible Bachelor or Master by Coursework program.
application_method: Check whether the intended RMIT program is eligible for the scholarship
Submit a standard international student application to RMIT
Scholarship is granted automatically with the offer letter; no separate scholarship form
existing.selection_notes: There is no separate selection or ranking process: RMIT states "No scholarship application is required" and that successful applicants "will receive an offer letter with the scholarship details outlined".
existing.best_fit: Students from India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Nepal or Pakistan who already hold an RMIT offer letter for a Bachelor or Masters by Coursework program starting from a 2026 intake.
existing.notes: Applicants currently in receipt of another RMIT funded scholarship or an Australia Awards scholarship covering tuition fees are excluded, except that applicants holding a scholarship loan may be considered.
existing.duration: Duration of the eligible program(s) as outlined in the offer letter
existing.application_period: Offer letter to commence from 2026 intakes onwards; no closing date is published.
existing.deadline_display: No scholarship application is required — RMIT states "No scholarship application is required"; the award is applied automatically to the tuition fees of an eligible offer letter.
existing.program_type: Automatic tuition fee reduction scholarship for international students from India and the subcontinent

existing.description: The Flinders International Postgraduate Research Scholarship (FIPRS) is a Flinders University-funded award for international students that pays the full international tuition fees for a research higher degree and provides a tax-free stipend of $36,061 per annum at the 2026 rate, paid fortnightly. Up to five scholarships are awarded annually to applicants selected on academic merit and research potential. It is tenable for up to 3.5 years for a Research Doctorate degree and up to two years for a Research Masters degree, with relocation, airfare and thesis allowances also available. Applicants must first secure a Flinders supervisor and lodge an HDR admission application before submitting the scholarship application.
eligibility: Be a citizen of any overseas country except New Zealand and not hold Australian citizenship, Australian permanent resident status or New Zealand citizenship
Intend to commence full-time study for a higher degree by research in Australia for the first time in the year for which the award is offered
Intend to enrol in an area of research concentration
Satisfy all entry requirements for a higher degree by research, including English proficiency levels; English test results must be valid until 31 March 2027
Not hold a qualification equivalent to an Australian Research Doctorate degree (or equivalent/higher Research Masters degree for Research Masters candidates)
Not have held an AusAID/Australia Award scholarship within the two years prior to commencing the FIPRS
Not be on paid study leave and not hold a fractional academic appointment greater than 0.2 FTE
existing.eligibility_summary: International (non-Australian, non-New Zealand citizen) applicants who will commence full-time study for a higher degree by research in Australia for the first time in the year of the award, intend to enrol in an area of research concentration, and satisfy all HDR entry requirements including English proficiency valid until 31 March 2027.
benefits: Payment of international tuition fees for the research higher degree
Stipend of $36,061.00 per annum tax free (2026 full time rate), paid fortnightly, indexed annually
Establishment allowance of up to $1,485 for relocation and airfares when moving to Adelaide from overseas
Thesis allowance of up to $500 to assist with thesis production costs
coverage: Full international student tuition fees for a research higher degree (max 4 years FTE doctoral, up to 2 years FTE Research Masters)
Tax-free stipend of $36,061 per annum (2026 rate), paid fortnightly
Relocation and travel establishment allowance of up to $1,485 after arrival in Adelaide, on production of receipts
requirements: Secure a Flinders academic staff member who agrees to supervise you and include email evidence of that agreement
Submit an HDR admission application first, then a scholarship application for the International RHD Scholarship Group
Provide up to five publications with completed coversheets showing a publication URL each
Provide certified university-level academic transcripts translated into English
Provide a research proposal of approximately 500 words
Have two referees return the Academic Referee's Confidential Report by the closing date
Provide an updated CV and evidence of English proficiency valid until 31 March 2027
Upload all documents in English as correctly oriented PDFs named with family name and document name
documents: Email evidence of agreement from an academic staff member to supervise you
Up to five publications, each with a completed publication coversheet showing the publication URL
Certified copies of all university-level academic transcripts, translated into English where necessary
Research proposal of approximately 500 words outlining the problem, hypothesis or question and the methodology or approach
Two completed Academic Referee's Confidential Reports returned by the referees to hdr.scholarships@flinders.edu.au by the closing date
Updated curriculum vitae covering work experience, research experience and a full list of cited publications
Evidence of English proficiency valid until 31 March 2027
existing.english_requirement: Must satisfy the English Language Proficiency Requirements for HDR Candidature; English test results must be valid until 31 March 2027 or the scholarship application is deemed ineligible.
application_method: Register and lodge an HDR admission application via Studylink and obtain a Flinders Student ID
Activate your Flinders account with the Student ID and date of birth to receive a Flinders Authentication Name (FAN)
Submit the scholarship application for the International RHD Scholarship Group through the Student System
Ensure two referee reports reach hdr.scholarships@flinders.edu.au by the closing date
existing.selection_notes: Selection is by the Scholarships Committee on academic merit and research potential; applications are scored on academic merit, academic research training merit and research outputs (maximum 5 publications). The University gives priority to students undertaking a higher degree by research for the first time. Applicants for the AGRTPS are automatically considered for the FIPRS, and the highest ranked eligible applicants are offered an AGRTPS, with FIPRS awards going to the next highest ranked eligible applicants.
existing.best_fit: Overseas applicants commencing a PhD or Masters by Research at Flinders for the first time who have published research and can satisfy the maximum-five-publications selection requirement.
existing.notes: For visa purposes the FIPRS is not a Commonwealth Sponsored Scholarship. The award is terminated if the holder is granted Australian permanent resident status, in which case the stipend converts to a FURS.
existing.duration: 3.5 years for a Research Doctorate degree; up to 2 years for a Research Masters degree
existing.application_period: 2027 HDR Annual Scholarship Round - International: opened 30 April 2026, closed 18 June 2026; applicants must first lodge an HDR admission application and then a scholarship application.
existing.deadline_display: Applications close Thursday 18 June 2026 Australian Central Standard Time (2027 HDR Annual Scholarship Round - International).
existing.program_type: University-funded international higher degree by research scholarship
